integrity: The fixed-code all-field theorem is supported by a complete mathematical proof; finite-field graph and code checks were reproduced using the attached standard-library verifier. No independent audit or independent validation was undertaken.
limitations: All graph claims are for column-primal graphs of parity checks of an existing linear MDS code; some presentations require dependent check rows. Edge count is not decoder runtime, treewidth, hardware cost, or a non-MDS guarantee. General proof uses MDS projection ranks and simplicial induction; finite computations only corroborate it. Absolute priority over older or unindexed literature is not certified.
title: Chordal parity-check topologies of MDS codes are exactly the highly connected chordal graphs
